theme: Protecting memory from cosmic rays cheaply
title: Cosmic-Ray Layout: Interleave Cheap Codes Around Physical Bursts
strategies: whole-row / largest-sub-N-block naive coverage (trivial, checker's own baseline)
contiguous ('logical order') blocking, searched over word length for cheapest sufficient code (greedy)
physical interleaving: spread the codeword mod the interleave distance so a burst is pigeonholed across many codewords, searched jointly with contiguous over both layout and word length (strong)
heterogeneous / non-uniform per-region mixes of layout and code choice (open ceiling, uncovered)
